title: Determinism scope clarification - profile claims must distinguish determinism levels

defect_summary.conflated_claims: Determinism claims were not qualified by scope. A 'deterministic' result from a CARLA-disabled run (UP_DISABLE_CARLA=1) was treated identically to a full live-CARLA validated run, even though the latter includes runtime validation the former cannot provide.
defect_summary.stage_digest_incomplete: stage_digest.py returned a digest even when SOURCE_FILES list was empty (no files found). This was treated as a valid deterministic result rather than EMPTY/INCOMPLETE.
defect_summary.profile_claim_conflation: No distinction between CORE_OFFLINE_DETERMINISM (pipeline stages deterministic given same inputs), THESIS_STRICT_DETERMINISM (includes FBX roundtrip + perceptual metrics), FULL_VISUAL_DETERMINISM (includes UE4 cook + CARLA runtime), and RUNTIME_DETERMINISM (includes live CARLA streaming). A 'deterministic' claim without profile qualification was meaningless.
defect_summary.carla_disabled_claims: Runs with UP_DISABLE_CARLA=1 or missing Blender/OSM2World could still claim 'deterministic' for stages that require those tools, because missing tools returned 'skipped' rather than 'blocked'.

corrected_semantics.stage_digest_states: generate_stage_hashes() now returns state in {COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, EMPTY}. COMPLETE = all SOURCE_FILES present and hashed. INCOMPLETE = some expected files missing. EMPTY = no source files found (directory empty or missing). Only COMPLETE is determinism-claim eligible.

determinism_profiles.CORE_OFFLINE_DETERMINISM: Pipeline stages (OSM->XODR, enrichment, tiling, XODR verification) are deterministic given same inputs. No CARLA, no Blender, no UE4. This is the baseline determinism claim.
determinism_profiles.THESIS_STRICT_DETERMINISM: CORE_OFFLINE + FBX roundtrip integrity (J6) + perceptual metrics (collision, LOD, semantic overlap) all pass. Requires Blender but not CARLA/UE4.
determinism_profiles.FULL_VISUAL_DETERMINISM: THESIS_STRICT + UE4 cook determinism + CARLA visual smoke gate pass. Requires UE4 + CARLA.
determinism_profiles.RUNTIME_DETERMINISM: FULL_VISUAL + live CARLA streaming determinism (spawn points, traffic, sensor determinism). Requires live CARLA server.

corrected_semantics.profile_claims_required: Any determinism claim MUST be qualified with one of the above profiles. Unqualified 'deterministic' is invalid.
corrected_semantics.tool_availability_enforcement: Blender/OSM2World/CARLA unavailable -> status='blocked' (not 'skipped') for stages requiring them. This prevents silent degradation of determinism claims.

tests.stage_digest: stage_digest.py tests updated to expect EMPTY state when directory has no source files, INCOMPLETE when some expected files missing
tests.determinism_profiles: New test file test_determinism_profiles.py verifies profile claims and tool availability enforcement

regression_results.stage_digest: Existing tests pass (updated for EMPTY/INCOMPLETE states)

residual_risks: Profile claims are self-declared by pipeline stages. No central registry enforces that a stage claiming THESIS_STRICT actually ran all required checks. Convention over enforcement.
UE4 cook determinism is not yet implemented (blocked on UE4 build track). FULL_VISUAL_DETERMINISM is currently theoretical.
RUNTIME_DETERMINISM requires live CARLA server and is not testable in CI. Marked as BLOCKED_EXTERNAL in practice.
